space.expression: Space of the chosen residual lattice solver, plus polynomial storage.

notes: An early explicitly described guessing/lattice hybrid. This basic binary-secret formula is distinct from the later meet-in-the-middle hybrid with a binary error distribution.

extra.parameters: Fix n,m,q, error standard deviation σ and k guessed secret coordinates.
extra.noise: Independent discrete Gaussian errors, standard deviation σ.
extra.secret: Uniform binary secret in {0,1}^n for the 2^k factor; ternary guessing would cost 3^k.
extra.samples: m original samples, preserved after subtracting a candidate partial secret; no extra oracle samples assumed.
extra.model: Exhaust partial secret values then apply a specified residual lattice attack C_lattice.
extra.assumptions: Residual solver’s cost/success assumptions; expected or repeated cost must use a consistent success target.
extra.success: The correct guess reduces to the smaller instance; overall success follows the residual solver.

evidence.locator: §6.4, p. 12, combining the lattice attack with exhaustive search
